headline: Copied code is not where this codebase's bloat is: 1.0% of non-test code is an exact copy (4,803 of 472,586 lines) and 4.75% a near-copy with every name and literal normalised; tests and e2e are no worse. The fourteen checked findings are true duplicates or missing checks, none rests on a feature being unused, and their corrected savings add up to about 5,500 lines (1.2%); the two I added are small too (about 1,100 to 1,500 test lines of repeated scaffolding, and helpers re-solved under one name such as addDays in 10 files). Do first: one store-address helper for the 27 hand-written lookups behind production's most-called statement (560,090 calls with no shoppers) and a copy ratchet in CI. Do before opening, while tables hold only test rows: one import definition, one scoped engine for the platform's workflows and deliveries, and one Work view. One correction to both earlier passes: a store's slug is rewritten once, when a sandbox is kept, so the cached helper needs a tag and must not remember sandboxes.

findings.title: Five file imports each repeat the upload, register, start-check, start-apply and cursor code, the browser flow, the findings table, the pages and the routes
findings.saving: About 1,300 to 1,600 code lines (estimate) and 13 route handlers (15 become 2).

findings.title: A store's address by its id is looked up by hand in 27 places beside a cached helper that already exists; it is production's most-called statement
findings.saving: 27 hand-written lookups become one helper; fewer database calls per uncached render, number unknown until measured.

findings.title: Admin form fields, tables and loading skeletons are spelled out per file because the UI kit has no piece for them
findings.saving: About 900 to 1,100 lines (estimate); the gain that matters is one look per control.

findings.title: The platform console has a second engine for workflows, own endpoints and integration deliveries beside the stores' engines
findings.saving: About 300 to 450 lines with shared engines (estimate).

findings.title: Work's account-level screens are copies of the store-level ones, and 58 Work actions are wrapped in a seven-line shell
findings.saving: About 650 lines (estimate: 400 from the views, 250 from the wrappers).

findings.title: Tripletex and Fiken are twins: the sync runner, the settings page and the actions
The one wrapper for server actions is marked Done but carries 3 of the admin's 235 action files, and nothing counts the rest
findings.saving: About 150 lines; one failure path for admin actions and a count that can only fall.

findings.title: Small helpers are declared again in file after file
findings.saving: About 300 to 500 lines net (estimate); 953 gross before the import lines that replace the copies.

findings.title: Three SQL fragments are typed out in dozens of files: the product title with its fallback, the usage counter and the order event
findings.saving: About 250 lines (estimate) and one definition of the title a person sees.

findings.title: Eleven server files hand-write the same claim-with-a-lease statement for their own queue table; ten more use skip locked in other ways
findings.saving: About 100 to 150 lines (estimate); not worth doing for the lines alone.

findings.title: The affiliate and bonus settings forms are one form written twice
On the storefront an order's totals are drawn in two places (and a third, looser, in checkout) and the product card's query is written twice
findings.saving: About 160 lines and one place for what a shopper is shown as owed.

findings.title: English words are kept twice: in a lib module and again in the English catalogue
Nothing in CI measures copied code, so each new kind or twin is made by copying a neighbour
findings.saving: Removes no lines; holds copied code at about 4,800 exact and 22,400 near lines.

findings.title: Integration tests repeat their scaffolding: 448 stub a module the config already stubs, next/cache is stubbed in five spellings, and 233 build their own store
findings.saving: About 1,100 test lines at once and about 1,500 with a shared store helper; no production code.

findings.title: Day arithmetic, country names and the money label are re-solved under one name in many modules with different bodies; the copy detector sees none of it
findings.saving: About 150 to 250 lines (estimate), and one answer per question.
